question: A solenoid with self-inductance $L$ and resistance $R$ is connected to a battery of EMF $\varepsilon$. At $t=0$, the switch is closed. After a long time, the battery is suddenly replaced by an AC source $V = V_0 \sin(\omega t)$ where $V_0 = \varepsilon$. Compare the maximum magnetic energy stored in the solenoid in the DC case ($U_{DC}$) versus the AC case ($U_{AC}$). Find the ratio $U_{DC} / U_{AC}$.
